evd_title: LLM confounder designation was highly inconsistent with Cohen kappa as low as 0.13 across prompt variations
finding: LLM confounder designation was highly inconsistent with Cohen kappa as low as 0.13 across prompt variations
P: 172 candidate confounders (112 expert-considered + 60 non-confounders), Coronary Drug Project, causal inference/medicine
I: Claude 3.5 Sonnet, GPT-4o (temp 0.7, 10 calls), GPT-o1-preview (1 call); few-shot (3 worked examples), MCQ, direct/indirect prompts
C: Same models across prompt variants (direct vs indirect, reasoning vs not, option order)
O: Direct vs indirect kappa: o1 0.16, Claude 0.21, GPT-4o 0.24; option order: 36.7% of Claude labels changed (kappa 0.41 table vs .13 text)
T: Not reported; expert sets from CDPRG 1980, Murray & Hernan 2016, Debertin 2024 (paper 2024)
